title: Rabbi Abba bar Ze’ira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him under this name once, in Midrash Tehillim 28:4; and proposes Rabbi Ahavah bar Ze’ira, as in Bereshit Rabbah 84:9. Yalkut, Shmuel, remez 149, reads Rabbi Acha bar Ze’ira, and Hyman identifies these as one person, for in the Jerusalem Talmud Ahavah is sometimes called Achavah or Acha bar Ze’ira. So too he is mentioned in Devarim Rabbah 4:4.
